newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:

Net sales of 87,200 MT were up 53 percent from the previous week, but down 16 percent from the 4-week average. The major buyers were Japan (40,600 MT) and Israel (36,600 MT). Decreases of 21,000 MT were reported for Chile.
Exports of 38,500 MT fell 70 percent from the prior week and the 4-week average. The destinations were Israel (22,400 MT), Mexico (14,000 MT), and Japan (2,000 MT).
